name: WPNuxt Plugin
upgrade_notice: WPNuxt no longer needs Faust.js. Turn on the public redirect, preview links and permalink rewrites in the WPNuxt settings before deactivating Faust.
author: Wouter Vernaillen

sections.description: WPNuxt is a plugin that helps you to integrate Nuxt.js with a headless WordPress.
sections.changelog:
0.0.6

  • The homepage, posts page and post type archive entries in Yoast's sitemaps point to the Nuxt frontend too.

0.0.5

  • Fix a fatal error on front-end requests when the public redirect is on and Faust.js is not active.
  • The release zip contains a wpnuxt-plugin folder, so WordPress installs it under the right name and can replace an existing install.

0.0.4

  • Own public route redirect to the Nuxt frontend, replacing Faust.js's, with an option to let Wordfence Central pair.
  • Editor previews open on the Nuxt frontend.
  • Post, page and term links and sitemap URLs point to the Nuxt frontend.
  • Faust.js is no longer a required plugin.
  • Optional frontend cache purge (nuxt-multi-cache) when a post or page is saved.
  • REST route wpnuxt/v1/updated returns when content last changed.
  • WPNuxt item in the admin bar.
  • The block editor opens without fullscreen mode by default.

0.0.3

WPNuxt in the admin menu, GitHub release setup.

0.0.2

Plugin release.
